# Duo Status Bar [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fkvmy666%2FduoStatusBar%2Fmain%2Fdocs%2Fbadges%2Fdownloads.json&query=%24.downloads&label=Downloads&color=blue&logo=github)](https://github.com/kvmy666/duoStatusBar/releases) [![Latest release](https://badgen.net/github/release/kvmy666/duoStatusBar)](https://github.com/kvmy666/duoStatusBar/releases) [![Android 13+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-13%2B-3ddc84)](https://developer.android.com) Duo Status Bar replaces the battery, Wi-Fi and mobile signal icons in your status bar with one clean, animated indicator. It is an LSPosed module. It does not modify system files. It only hides the icons it replaces and draws the new indicator.

## Requirements - Android 13 or newer. - A custom ROM with root. - LSPosed installed. ## Install 1. Download the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/kvmy666/duoStatusBar/releases) and install it. 2. Open LSPosed, go to Modules, and enable Duo Status Bar. 3. In the module's scope, tick **System UI**. 4. Restart System UI, or reboot the phone. 5. Open the Duo Status Bar app and turn the main switch on. The module is off until you turn it on. Nothing changes before that. ## Supported UIs | UI | Support | | --- | --- | | OnePlus OxygenOS 16 | ✅ | | Xiaomi HyperOS 3 | ✅ | | OPPO/realme ColorOS | ✅ | | Samsung One UI | ✅ | | vivo OriginOS | ✅ | | Honor MagicOS | ✅ | | Motorola MyOS | ✅ | | Nothing OS | ✅ | ## Customization | Default | Default · Invert center | |:---:|:---:| | | | | **Two SIM** | **Two SIM · Invert center** | | | | Changing the size needs a System UI restart. The app has a button for it. ## PHDP integration Duo can show download progress from PHDP on the ring. 1. Install [PHDP](https://github.com/hxreborn/punch-hole-download-progress/releases/latest). 2. In PHDP, open **System → Integrations** and choose **Duo**. 3. Start a download. Progress appears on the Duo ring. ## If something goes wrong - Issues: https://github.com/kvmy666/duoStatusBar/issues - Telegram: https://t.me/kvmy1 Send a report from the app's **About** section. It includes your device details and the logs, which makes the problem much easier to find. ## Support If you like the app, you can support the developer: [Buy Me a Coffee](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/kroomfahd) or [PayPal](https://paypal.me/kroomfahd). ## License GPL-3.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# Duo 状态栏 [![下载](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fkvmy666%2FduoStatusBar%2Fmain%2Fdoc s%2Fbadges%2Fdownloads.json&query=%24.downloads&label=Downloads&color=blue&logo=github)](https://github.com/kvmy666/duoStatusBar/releases) [![最新版本](https://badgen.net/github/release/kvmy666/duoStatusBar)](https://github.com/kvmy666/duoStatusBar/releases) [![Android 13+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-13%2B-3ddc84)](https://developer.android.com) Duo Status Bar 将状态栏中的电池、Wi-Fi 和移动信号图标替换为一个干净、 动画指示器。 它是一个 LSPod 模块。它不会修改系统文件。它只隐藏它替换和绘制的图标 新指标。

## 要求 - Android 13 或更高版本。 - 具有 root 权限的自定义 ROM。 - 已安装LSPod。 ## 安装 1. 从[Releases](https://github.com/kvmy666/duoStatusBar/releases)下载APK并安装。 2. 打开 LSPod，转到模块，然后启用 Duo 状态栏。 3. 在模块范围中，勾选**系统 UI**。 4. 重新启动系统UI，或重新启动话机。 5. 打开 Duo Status Bar 应用程序并打开主开关。 在您将其打开之前，模块将处于关闭状态。在此之前什么都没有改变。 ## 支持的用户界面 |用户界面|支持| | --- | --- | | OnePlus OxygenOS 16 | ✅ | |小米HyperOS 3 | ✅ | | OPPO/realme ColorOS | ✅ | |三星 One UI | ✅ | | vivo OriginOS | ✅ | |荣耀MagicOS | ✅ | |摩托罗拉 MyOS | ✅ | |没有操作系统| ✅ | ## 定制 |默认|默认 · 反转中心 | |:---:|:---:| | | | | **两张 SIM 卡** | **双卡·反转中心** | | | | 更改大小需要重新启动系统 UI。该应用程序有一个按钮。 ## PHPP 集成 Duo 可以在环上显示 PHPP 的下载进度。 1.安装[PHPP](https://github.com/hxreborn/punch-hole-download-progress/releases/latest)。 2. 在 PHPP 中，打开 **系统 → 集成** 并选择 **Duo**。 3. 开始下载。 Duo 环上会显示进度。 ## 如果出现问题 - 问题：https://github.com/kvmy666/duoStatusBar/issues - 电报：https://t.me/kvmy1 从应用程序的**关于**部分发送报告。它包括您的设备详细信息和日志，其中 使问题更容易找到。 ## 支持 如果您喜欢该应用程序，您可以支持开发者： [请我喝杯咖啡](https://www.buymeacoffee.com/kroomfahd) 或 [PayPal](https://paypal.me/kroomfahd)。 ## 许可证 GPL-3.0。请参阅[许可证]（许可证）。
